correctness.rationale: Finite and countable masks decompose into row/column blow-ups of J_m-I_m with at most one universal row and column, plus an infinite-deletion limit 2. The blow-up norm invariance follows by weight merging in Levene duality. Averaging over known graph automorphisms yields exactly three one-variable trace-norm formulas. Direct eigenvalue calculations, differentiations, m=0,1 and all cutoff checks are reconstructed in RESULT.md. Standalone diagnostics were rerun from the packaged path.

originality.rationale: Levene 2026 §6 Question 6.4 frames interiors of the signed-block-complexity norm sets but does not give the exact difference-sector spectrum. The known J_m-I_m rational sequence and the 9/7 three-site example are explicitly credited and are only proper subsets of the new complete classification. Goh-Hatami 2025 bounds general complexity, but no exact three-template spectral theorem was identified. A pre-existing equivalent global theorem remains a genuine publication-priority risk.

value.rationale: An exact global norm classification for the opposite-sign first-open two-blocky complexity class gives five isolated algebraic exceptions, an entire infinite rational sequence, and one accumulation point. It excludes that whole sign sector as a source of intervals in Levene 2026 Question 6.4 and identifies a necessary mechanism for solving the still-open positive-sum case. The result is not a mere known numerical-table recomputation.
